fn router(data_dir: &std::path::Path, args: &[&str]) -> std::process::Output {
    Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_router"))
        .arg("--data-dir")
        .arg(data_dir)
        .args(args)
        .env("TOKEN_SECRET", "logs-command-secret")
        .output()
        .expect("router runs")
}
